blocks.text: ORLANDO, Florida — Joel Embiid scored 26 points, VJ Edgecombe added a season-high 24 and LeBron James finished with 22 as the Philadelphia 76ers beat Orlando 121-116 in the NBA on Wednesday night, halting the Magic’s four-game winning streak. Philadelphia rallied from an early 17-point deficit and improved to 13-3, it’s best start in 26 years. The team opened the 2000-01 season 14-2 en route to an appearance in the NBA Finals.
